title: ASTRODRIFTER
description:
Astrodrifter combines the delicate art of drifting with fast-paced, top down, dogfighting. Fight your way through hordes of fighters, raid heavily fortified bases, take down deadly enemy capital ships, all to become The Astrodrifter.

Astrodrifter features a Rouge-lite campaign where choices matter and daring victories are well rewarded. You chose where to go, when to strike and when to run (though... if you run, you may be followed). Chose your battles wisely, as fortune only favours those who fight and survive.

Being a good shot and an artful drifter won't be enough to defeat your enemies. Upgrading your ship and curating your loadout for the fights you chose are just as important as developing your skills.

Still want more? Push your skills and cooperation to the limits in split-screen challenge levels. Only the most adept Astrodrifters will survive.
description_short: A fast-paced, top down movement shooter. A drifter must master the art of drifting, the nature of the enemy and the rhythm of attack and defence. Only then can a drifter become The Astrodrifter.
